description: Renovate follows the CI pipeline cadence, a SCHEDULE_KIND=deep-check pipeline schedule, and a manual web run is intentional; so no schedule window here, and no hourly PR limit. Why: design/agent-workflow.md.

customManagers.description: The R image tag lives in the R_VERSION variable of .gitlab-ci.yml, because the cache key needs it too, and the gitlabci manager cannot follow a tag through a variable. This bumps the line under the `# renovate:` comment.

packageRules.description: Group CI image bumps into a single weekly MR. This is the whole job for an R package: there is no CRAN manager, and DESCRIPTION declares version floors resolved against current CRAN at install time, so nothing else here is pinned. Replaces the old Dependabot `github-actions` group, which kept the r-lib/actions pins current.
